common_patterns.overview: Reusable mobile development patterns and code examples for React Native and Flutter applications. These patterns follow best practices for cross-platform development, performance optimization, and platform-specific implementations.

pattern.name: platform_detection
pattern.description: Detect and handle platform-specific code and features
pattern.explanation: Use Platform.OS to conditionally render components or apply platform-specific styles and behaviors.

pattern.name: shared_service_layer
pattern.explanation: Create shared interfaces and implement platform-specific versions. Use Platform.select() to get the correct implementation at runtime.

pattern.name: responsive_layout
pattern.description: Adaptive layouts for different screen sizes and orientations
pattern.explanation: Use Dimensions API to create responsive layouts that adapt to different screen sizes and orientations.

pattern.name: offline_data_manager
pattern.description: Offline-first data synchronization with conflict resolution
pattern.explanation: Implement a robust offline data manager with action queuing, conflict resolution, and sync capabilities.

pattern.name: image_optimization
pattern.description: Efficient image loading and caching for mobile
pattern.explanation: Use FastImage for optimized image loading with caching, progressive rendering, and proper placeholder handling.

pattern.name: memory_management
pattern.description: Efficient memory usage and cleanup patterns
pattern.explanation: Properly manage timers, listeners, and other resources to prevent memory leaks in React components.

pattern.name: battery_optimization
pattern.explanation: Implement battery-conscious background task management that pauses/resumes based on app state and uses platform-optimized intervals.

pattern.name: biometric_authentication
pattern.explanation: Implement platform-specific biometric authentication using TouchID for iOS and BiometricManager for Android.

pattern.name: push_notifications
pattern.description: Unified push notification setup for FCM and APNS
pattern.explanation: Create a unified push notification service that handles both FCM (Android) and APNS (iOS) with consistent interface.

pattern.name: platform_testing
pattern.explanation: Create platform testing utilities that allow testing platform-specific code paths and behaviors consistently across different platforms.

pattern.name: navigation_integration
pattern.explanation: Implement platform-specific navigation components while maintaining a shared navigation service interface for consistent behavior across platforms.
